summary: The test case compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly. It preserves the test case ID in the title and uses a data-test attribute selector which is good practice. However, the URL assertion is broad and may not reliably verify navigation to the correct product detail page. This results in a warning for weak navigation validation.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a generic regular expression (/product/), which might allow false positives and does not confirm that the specific product detail page has loaded.
issues.recommendation: Use a more specific URL pattern or validate the presence of unique product detail elements on the page to strengthen the assertion.

recommendations: Enhance URL assertion to be more specific or supplement with assertions on distinct product detail page elements.
Continue using data-test attribute selectors as they tend to be resilient and maintainable.
Consider adding checks for product details content to improve test robustness.
